name: Ektopa: Rush the Void
summary:
# Build. Discover. Race.

Create tracks. Discover new paths. Compete for the best solution.

Every surface, every structure can become your route.
There is no single way forward.

# Key Features

- Build and share custom tracks
- Discover new paths in every run
- Move across walls, ceilings, and space
- Compete in multiplayer and leaderboards
- Learn from others with ghost racing
